environment.description: ECS Fargate service running Node.js 18 container behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the container on port 3000. No request body inspection or filtering is configured. CDN scripts are loaded without integrity attributes. Container runs with default ECS task execution role. No Content-Security-Policy headers are set. The service is deployed in a public subnet with internet-facing ALB.
